visualCharacteristics.description: One drawer per grey band: full-width header photo with a slanted overlay at the bottom edge, centred dark-blue title, round +/- toggle; the panel shows a blue intro paragraph and 1-4 case-study tiles (image, bold title, link). Native details/summary.
visualCharacteristics.purpose: expandable benefit stories with case studies

contentPattern.description: 1 row per drawer: [header photo + title text (paragraph) | intro paragraph(s), then repeated case-study groups: image, bold title paragraph, link paragraph].
contentPattern.structure: 1 row per drawer: [header photo + title | intro + case-study groups (image, bold title, link)]
